context.profile: Data scientist who checks the data before the model: audited 859,494 training examples for gaps and duplicates, and combined 14 research datasets for my AstraZeneca-affiliated MSc dissertation. At 180 Degrees Consulting, led the design in a five-person team that turned a startup's vague idea into a working AI prototype in three months (rated 5 stars); it is now in live use. Handles the whole data workflow in Python and SQL, from combining raw data to testing and deploying the model (Docker, AWS). MSc Data Science, University of Bristol (completed 2026). Over a year of hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning and LLM systems.

skills.Experimentation: experimental design (MSc coursework), power analysis, hypothesis testing, ANOVA
skills.Machine Learning, Deep Learning & Statis: Machine learning concepts, statistical analysis (descriptive statistics, correlation analysis), predictive modelling (gradient boosting with XGBoost, random forest, scikit-learn), clustering (K-Means, HAC, DBSCAN, Leiden), deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, LSTM, BiRNN, CNN), time-series forecasting (cyclic time encoding, TimeSeriesSplit), anomaly detection (Isolation Forest), class-imbalance handling (SMOTE), hyper-parameter tuning (grid search, two-stage Bayesian), model evaluation (held-out, cross-validation, Pearson, MCC), MLflow experiment tracking
skills.Python, Data Quality & Cloud: Python, pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, SQL, PostgreSQL, R (tidymodels), identifier crosswalks, parquet, reproducible pipelines, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), serverless deployment (AWS Lambda), containerisation, GitHub Actions CI/CD, FastAPI, TensorFlow Serving, pytest, Git
skills.NLP, LLMs, Embeddings & Evaluation: NLP (text preprocessing, TF-IDF, SBERT embeddings, text clustering), Hugging Face Transformers, large language models (Claude, OpenAI, open-weight via Ollama), prompt engineering, RAG with embeddings (ChromaDB), agents (LangChain, LangGraph), team LoRA fine-tune of Llama, LLM evaluation (hallucination-rate analysis, deterministic guardrails)
